question: Does the schema-v9 migration and split parent/evidence freshness contract preserve existing writable databases and legacy portable archive reads sufficiently to land?
rationale: The patch changes durable ordering semantics across canonical records and derived state; focused tests reduce risk, but accepting the persistent upgrade contract requires store-owner intent.

options.title: Complete store-owner review
options.body: Confirm migration high-water backfill, legacy read-only fallback, and representative upgraded databases before merging.

options.title: Keep the branch draft
options.body: Pause landing until maintainers are prepared to own the new persistent ordering contract.

recommendation.title: Complete store-owner review
recommendation.body: Confirm migration high-water backfill, legacy read-only fallback, and representative upgraded databases before merging.
